description: Response actions for audit processing failures are not defined or implemented.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing audit failure alerting mechanisms, undefined response procedures, or no designated personnel for audit failure notifications.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Audit and Accountability
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
